sections.Profile:
The "Super Mario Bros." pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in 1992, is a unique blend of the beloved video game franchise and traditional pinball mechanics. Designed by Jon Norris, this machine features a vibrant playfield with familiar characters like Mario, Luigi, and Bowser, and incorporates sound effects directly from the video game series. Key gameplay elements include three flippers, three pop bumpers, two vertical up-kickers, and an elevated mini-playfield, providing a dynamic and engaging experience for players.
